name: Utopia predictable airdrop balance overwrite
summary: Utopia._airdrop overwrites rather than increments a predictably chosen address balance. A crafted pair skim overwrote the pair’s Utopia balance, allowing sync and tiny subsequent sales to drain WBNB reserves.
notes: startTrade enables the arbitrary-recipient pair transfer that makes the chosen balance overwrite possible; before activation the !Trade gate permits only liquidity additions to the fixed mainPair.

WBNB extracted from pair 0xfeef619a56fce9d003e20bf61393d18f62b0b2d5: 492.088605739133158123 in the anchor plus six later payouts totaling 3.657063239971340118, less the attacker’s 0.01 WBNB purchase input. Protocol fee conversions retained as MT for LP rewards are excluded. No separate value is assigned to overwritten or unsold Utopia balances; gas and subsequent transfers do not reduce gross loss. WBNB is valued at the timestamped BNB/USD sample.
